notes.title: Release as Early Access: July 25, 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3][p] We are excited to announce [b]"Hedgehog and Cat: Explore the World Action"[/b] will release into Early Access on July 25, 2025.[/p][p] we offer a [b]40% discount for the first two weeks (14 days)[/b] after the Early Access launch![/p][p][/p][p]Early Access Release Date: July 25, 2025[/p][p]Price: $11.99 USD 
[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3019770/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065071/06a01016747ec4e06d34aaaacd6a9e036209f392.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h3][p] “We plan to gradually raise the price as we ship new content and features.”[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your support. [/p]
